title: Egyptian Funerary Portraits
content: Realistic portraits adorned the tops of the caskets in Roman Egypt.The portraits were first discovered in the 19th century, and even to this day no one is completely sure how they were painted.Some of the portraits are painted over a dimensional, sculpted base layer.Modern researchers are carefully scraping off bits of paint and discovering the mix of wax and pigments. They're even using machine learning models to understand the patterns of brushstrokes.But they're not much closer to knowing who the artists were or what they were thinking.
